title: Florida Weekend Guide: Games, Protests and Night Lights
igCaption:
Big game, early voting push, and lights you can walk through.
Oct. 17, Hard Rock Stadium.

Sources: Local 10, WLRN, CBS News, Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#Miami #FloridaEvents #WeekendGuide #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Miami versus Florida State leads the weekend in South Florida.
Miami, ranked number three, hosts Florida State at Hard Rock Stadium on Saturday night. The game is another chapter in a heated rivalry, and rain could add another challenge.

scenes.text: No Kings returns in South Florida with a focus on early voting ahead of the midterms.

scenes.text: At Traz Powell Stadium, Columbus beat Miami Central 28 to 3 in the GMAC Championship Game. Columbus improved to 8-1. The game ended early because of weather. If you were there, NEAR shows who else braved Traz Powell too.

scenes.text: Luminosa returns to Jungle Island for its 2026 edition. The walk runs 1.35 miles, with more than 43,600 LEDs and seven custom zones.

scenes.text: NightGarden opens at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden on November 12. This year adds an ice rink under the palms, a 60-minute route, illuminated pathways, larger-than-life sculptures, and food trucks.

scenes.text: Which one would you actually show up for this weekend? Between the games, protests, and night lights, the stranger you kept passing all day is exactly the kind of person NEAR app can put a name to.
